title: About Jyatin Kumar Singh
content: I'm Jyatin Kumar Singh, a B.Tech Computer Science student at Lovely Professional University, graduating in 2028. I build full-stack applications, practise data structures and algorithms, explore AI and RAG systems, and contribute to open source. My main stack is JavaScript and TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB, with C++ and Java for problem solving. I enjoy taking an idea from a rough concept to a working product and focus on clean code, problem-solving, collaboration, and high-performance user-centered applications.

title: VOXSHIELD — Real-Time Voice Deepfake Detection
content: VOXSHIELD is a voice deepfake detection and forensic analysis platform built around the E4 multi-scale raw-waveform CNN model. I built a real-time voice authenticity analysis workflow, integrated a FastAPI inference backend with a Next.js frontend, and designed waveform inspection, detection-result and forensic-analysis interfaces while preserving the core audio-processing pipeline. Technologies include Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI and E4 CNN.

title: JalDrishti 2030 — IoT-AI Digital Twin
content: JalDrishti 2030 is the software implementation of the research paper titled “JalDrishti 2030: An IoT–AI Digital Twin for Predictive Water-Stress and Intervention Planning in Bengaluru.” It is a research-facing prototype for water-stress analysis, forecasting, digital-twin simulation, scenario exploration and intervention planning. The implementation explicitly separates measured evidence, synthetic demonstration data, simulated outputs and proposed EPANET/WNTR and NSGA-II methodology. Technologies include Next.js, TypeScript, digital-twin concepts, EPANET/WNTR and NSGA-II.

title: AskPDF — RAG-Powered Document Q&A System
content: AskPDF is a RAG-powered document Q&A system with a five-stage Node.js pipeline for PDFs up to 20 MB. It generates 768-dimensional embeddings for semantic vector search, uses Redis BRPOP workers for asynchronous processing, tracks jobs and cleans up stale jobs, and applies a similarity threshold greater than 0.7 before retrieved context reaches the LLM to reduce unsupported answers. Technologies include Node.js, RAG, Redis, Gemini and vector search.

title: KiranaWala — Hyperlocal Smart Grocery Platform
content: KiranaWala is a MERN-based hyperlocal smart grocery platform connecting customers with nearby local stores. I architected customer and store workflows, developed authentication, product, cart, checkout and order-management flows with a MongoDB-backed API, and explored AI-assisted demand prediction for local inventory planning. Technologies include MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js and AI/ML.

title: FixMyWay — AI-Powered Civic Issue Reporting
content: FixMyWay is an AI-powered civic issue reporting mobile application built with React Native, Expo and Firebase. It supports GPS-tagged issue reporting, image uploads, duplicate detection, Gemini Vision validation, issue classification, severity estimation and priority analysis using community confirmations and rainfall context.

title: MyString — Custom C++ String
content: MyString is a custom C++ String implementation created to understand string abstractions internally. It explores constructors, dynamic memory management, copying and operator overloading and strengthens object-oriented programming and low-level C++ fundamentals.

title: Crop Analysis — Multi-Temporal NDVI Crop Cycle
content: Crop Analysis is a web platform for extracting and analysing crop-cycle parameters from multi-temporal NDVI data. It connects frontend workflows with backend processing and data services and presents crop-cycle information through an interface focused on interpretable agricultural results.

title: Portfolio RAG assistant architecture
content: The portfolio assistant uses a small fixed corpus of semantically structured chunks. Each chunk represents a meaningful unit such as a project, experience entry, skill category, certification group or background section. The ingestion script embeds these chunks once. At query time the API embeds the question, computes cosine similarity against the local bundled vector index, keeps the top 5 candidates and only passes candidates above a 0.70 similarity threshold to the generation model. No visitor chat logs are persisted.
